semantic.justification: Task202610091517-S6Q035 ports the shared mdds3.2.1 owners used by sc segmenttree, keeping include/mdds source boundaries and original MIT notices/license. The optional native probe verifies complete dependency archives against pinned LibreOffice download.lst, applies its exact original gcc warning patch, verifies every actual mdds/Boost compiler header and compiles genuine unchanged headers with assertions and ASan/UBSan. Every native sequence retains all step results and full public snapshots; deduplication shares identical snapshots only. Original bounds/search/hint/shift contracts are retained, including suspicious overload asymmetry; invalid-border native null access is excluded from certification, with no guard fix. Proven unreachable malformed-tree/leaf diagnostics are expressed through source invariants with comments; no coverage exclusions or native-body rewrites. Only numeric Calc keys with initialized boolean/number values and native-defined arithmetic are implemented. Wider C++ templates and value classes, allocation/refcount/deletion timing, dangling iterators, debug dumps, generic exceptions and undefined invalid-border operations remain uncertified. GC references and explicit copy/move/operator methods adapt the language runtime. Finite native snapshots do not establish whole-module or Calc parity.
